(Retrieved via WebFetch; direct curl blocked by Cloudflare. Times of Israel liveblog entry, 22 October 2026, 08:12 Israel time)

Trump stated, "We are not negotiating with" Iran, adding that "Something one way or another will happen, fairly soon."
The president made these remarks while boarding Air Force One at Joint Base Andrews. He noted that most observers expect any action to occur following the November 3 midterm elections.
These comments follow reporting that the US and Israel have drafted plans for renewed military strikes on Iran after the American midterm elections, according to The New York Times.
